scope: Actual visual review of eight first-pass day/night images; this report precedes planting and illumination corrections

Conservatory glass outline, palm silhouettes and fountain are visible by day; at night the foliage/framing and foreground garden are substantially too dark.
Aerial view shows the extent of vegetation omitted by the authored-site context mask.
